name: Yata Hime
source:
Second year Advanced Course student, 17 years old.

She's a covert asset for the Agency who's been infiltrating the Academy ever since she was enrolled in it's elementary school divison. Mindful of the need to blend in, she tries not to stand out too much. Her relationships with other students are kept superficial as a result.

She always keeps a poker face, but beneath it all she's actually quite playful.

[spoiler]To keep her disguise from being blown, Hime started a fake relationship with Hikari, who ended up accidentally charming her with her powers.

Unbeknown to her pretend lover, she's been looking for a way to break the spell, but...[/spoiler]

[Translated from [url=https://x.com/fenrirvier/status/1981991239055761781]the author's Twitter.[/url]]
